M3.02 FINAL re-review at fd850b2ccc617eb877cfbcaa260c8eb60677c653 (vs 16f77784) — APPROVE-WITH-FIXES (small, non-blocking; source-level, no tests run).
Blobs: PatternArtifact.scala 7def87aa, PatternArtifactSuite.scala 217c43f8, AlderPatternArtifact.scala fa3c067f, AlderPatternArtifactSuite.scala 7f526ed6. Fresh-context reviewer; doc/branch items re-checked by me at :191-213.

RESOLVED
A per-column normalization (max-abs then 2-norm, Gram diag ~1), zero/non-finite column refused :94, empty :102, tolerance kept in GaugeEvidence :40/:161-162. Hand-worked: (1,1),(1,1+1e-7) -> pivot sin^2(theta) ~2.5e-15 <= 1e-12 refused (Gale pin refuses when sum <= tol); (1,1),(1,2) pivot 0.1 admitted; diag(1,1e-7)/diag(1,1e7) both normalize to I, mean (4,-3) preserved.
C centered() relative: |sum x/s| <= 1e-12 * sum|x/s| (:116-135); zero column skipped then refused by rank; (1e-150,1e-150) test genuinely fails on centering.
11 split ExpectedTrainingReceiptMismatch / ArtifactTrainingBindingMismatch with exact-cause tests (Alder :9-10, :28-29; suite :30-31, :34-35).
DeclaredSolverDiagnostic refusals restored (blank name, rank>K; rank<0 untested, minor). Continuous AxisMismatch reports actual key (prior branch tested, metric branch not). DiagonalPlusLowRank doc explicit (no Psi/loadings/solve).

FIX (small)
1 forwardMean doc (:191-193) only says "add the stored neural mean"; add that intercept artifacts require target values already centered under targetCenteringReceipt (the case doc :26-28 says it, the method callers read does not).
2 Unreachable K-1 branch (:205-213), incl. dead `case _ => targetAxis.size`, is uncommented; comment as defensive or remove.
3 (optional) suite :129 (1e150,-1e150) sums to exactly 0, so it would also pass the old absolute check; use e.g. 1e6*(0.1,0.2,-0.3) whose rounding residual exceeds 1e-10 to pin the relative behaviour.
NOTES: centered() tolerance ~K*eps*sum|x| could refuse correctly centered contrasts at K>=1e4 — one doc sentence; :70 message could mention per-column normalization. Portability fine (no JVM-only APIs; returns are in while loops, not lambdas). Alder suite `.cause` use unverified without compile.
